commit_locations.context: zero_total_value skip path (Portfolio Snapshot has zero total value)
commit_locations.rationale: Violates docstring contract 'NEVER commits'. When _evaluate_core is called inside the Worker child's session.begin() transaction (line 143 of orchestration_executor.py), this premature commit breaks atomicity: Guardian data is committed before lease validation and attempt/run/lease updates, which then run in a separate implicit transaction. If the Worker dies between these two transactions, orphaned Guardian evaluation data persists.
